record_title: Exact recurrence balances and a strict period floor for the Moore--Spiegel oscillator
provenance: A theorem for the Moore--Spiegel oscillator derived from two exact polynomial balance laws, invariant-measure generator identities, bounded-orbit convergence arguments, a zero-parameter first integral, and the sharp periodic Wirtinger inequality, compared with classic and modern Moore--Spiegel literature.
limitations: Invariant-measure statements require compact support. Bounded-orbit convergence for T<=0 is conditional on forward boundedness. The damping-threshold support result requires R>T>0. The period theorem constrains existing cycles and does not prove existence. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the full texts of Baker--Moore--Spiegel (1971) and Letellier--Malasoma (2014) were not inspected and remain residual coverage risks.
